title: RekindleSketch: Time-Aware Detection of Recent Persistent Flows via Arrival-Driven Rewards

problem.claim: Detect recent persistent flows that remain continuously active within the most recent R windows.

gap.claim: Existing methods face prohibitive memory overhead or unstable accuracy due to arrival gaps and hash collisions in limited memory.

contributions.claim: A time-aware data structure for detecting recent persistent flows.
A metric called memory score to quantify recent persistence.
A probabilistic replacement policy that tracks recent persistent flows and evicts flows that become inactive.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors describe RekindleSketch as a novel time-aware data structure and identify memory score as a new metric.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The paper provides theoretical analysis and extensive experimental tests.
The authors report that RekindleSketch outperforms state-of-the-art methods in accuracy and efficiency.
The source code is available on GitHub.

narrative_sequence.summary: Recent persistent flows are important for network situation recognition and anomaly detection.
Existing methods are limited by memory overhead and accuracy instability.
RekindleSketch introduces a time-aware data structure, memory score, and probabilistic replacement policy.
The paper reports theoretical analysis and experiments showing improved accuracy and efficiency.
The source code is reported as available on GitHub.
